description: Returns the passages for one day of a Cross + Covenant reading plan, by day number or, for the one-year M'Cheyne plan, by calendar date (today in Mountain Time when neither is given). With include_text, also returns the passage text (up to 150 verses) in the World English Bible or King James Version.

date.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form. One-year plan only.

day.description: Day number in the plan, starting at 1.

include_text.description: Also return the text of the day's passages. Default false.

plan_id.description: Plan id: "mcheyne" (one year) or a topical plan id.

translation.description: Translation: "web" (World English Bible, the default) or "kjv" (King James Version).

name: get_reading_plan_day
title: Get a reading plan day
